events.verdict: Timme (BKN) firms up over his left leg as he sets the pick and marginal contact occurs as Martin (WAS) attempts to defend over the pick.
Johnson (WAS) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently exiting.
Johnson (BKN) and Jones (WAS) engage and disengage while pursuing the loose ball and the contact is marginal.
Johnson (BKN) steps into Jones' (WAS) space and body contact occurs, which affects his layup attempt at the basket.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Watford (BKN) makes last contact with the ball prior to it coming down onto the sideline and out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to Washington.
Timme (BKN) legally contests Johnson's (WAS) jump shot attempt.
Thor (WAS) steps towards Johnson's (BKN) path as he moves to defend the drive and marginal lower body contact occurs.
Jones (WAS) reaches in for the ball and makes contact with it, which legally dislodges it from Johnson's (BKN) grasp.
Watford (BKN) jumps from point A to point B into Jones (WAS), delivering contact that affects Jones' driving shot attempt.

Timme's (BKN) arms come out slightly as he turns and establishes himself in a screening position. Johnson (WAS) attempts to defend around the pick and marginal contact occurs as Timme pulls his arms back towards his body.
Johnson (WAS) legally contests Martin's (BKN) jump shot attempt.
Timme (BKN) legally contests Jones' (WAS) driving shot attempt.
Timme (BKN) firms up over his right leg and marginal contact occurs as Johnson (WAS) moves into the pick.
Vukcevic (WAS) steps into Martin's (BKN) space and delivers contact, which impacts Martin's driving shot attempt at the basket.
Johnson (WAS) briefly brings his forearm to rest on TImme's (BKN) lower back and marginal contact occurs during the shot attempt at the basket.
Vukcevic (WAS) releases his inbound pass prior to five seconds elapsing after receiving the ball from the official.
Replay review confirms that Thor (WAS) makes illegal contact with the ball after it comes into contact with the backboard and is above rim-level with a chance to score.
Thor (WAS) firms up over his left leg as he establishes screening position and marginal contact occurs with Williams (BKN) as he defends around the screen.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Jones (WAS) makes last contact with the ball prior to it bouncing out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to Brooklyn.
Thor (WAS) commits a take foul on Wilson (BKN).
Jones (WAS) steps his right foot into the court of play, which reestablishes himself prior to coming into contact with the ball.
Jones (WAS) does not release the ball prior to the game clock expiring.
